items.title: Strive Buys $335 Million in Bitcoin After Investors Pour In $369 Million
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin holder bought as warrant holders exercised, bringing in $369 million, and it now plans a $630 million sale of 15% preferred stock.

items.title: Mt Gox Repayments Delayed Again as Bitcoin Billions Sit Idle
items.summary: Mt Gox creditors just lost another year to a repayment process that has dragged on since the exchange collapsed in 2014. The latest extension pushes the deadline into October 2027, leaving billions in bitcoin and some creditors still waiting for their funds. items.title: Abandoned Bitcoin? Wallet Targeted by Noah Doe Lawsuit Moves $33 Million
items.summary: A Bitcoin address dormant since 2013 moved 411.45 BTC worth about $33.4 million, according to Galaxy Research, and it's among the wallets named in the "Noah Doe" lawsuit.

items.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.
